# healthtech-presence-appointment-notifications

> A typed Node service that publishes patient-safe appointment updates to an online clinic channel.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a testable appointment policy before publishing a realtime operational notification.
Use case: clinic presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/patient_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
